fields.Format: N
fields.Field Explanation: SHARP CONTRAST WITH FORM 350. The instruction guide says this number is 'asignado por la natural person o juridica que expide la certificacion' - the EMPLOYER assigns it, not DIAN. On Form 350 casilla 4 is DIAN-assigned and opaque. The engine must therefore maintain its own certificate numbering series and keep it stable, because the employee quotes it. COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. Because DIAN prescribes NO structure, the series is Mercans-designed and is fixed here so that it is stable and auditable: positions 1-4 = accrual year AAAA, source PayPeriod.Fiscal_Year, the year the income was earned and NOT the year of issue; position 5 = literal hyphen; positions 6-11 = a six-digit zero-filled consecutive, source Mercans.Certificate_Sequence, restarting at 000001 for each accrual year and unique per employer per year. PERSISTENCE: assigned once and NEVER reused, including after a reissue - a corrected certificate takes the NEXT consecutive and cites the superseded number, because ET art. 378 makes the employee's copy the evidential document and two certificates may not share a number.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (code)
fields.Field Explanation: The instruction guide prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Minor ID card, 13 Citizenship ID card, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Foreign resident ID card, 31 NIT, 41 Passport. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here. SOURCE (client evidence): the client employee master holds NO document-type field. It holds one column per document - 'National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID' - and 14 of 261 employees have two or three of them populated. The engine must store an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, not infer it from which column is filled. The mapping of the client columns to Form 220 codes must be confirmed with the client: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22 are the evident candidates; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no evident code (they appear next to a Citizenship Card for Colombian nationals).
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA:
The Form 220 document-type list omits 47 (PEP) and has no PPT code at all. Confirm with the RA how a PEP or PPT holder should be certified - 41 (Passport) and 22 (Foreign resident ID card) are the only near neighbours and neither is correct.
Confirm with the client the mapping of the employee master document columns to the casilla-24 codes: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22 are the evident candidates; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no evident code (they appear next to a Citizenship Card for Colombian nationals).

fields.Format: N / AN
fields.Field Explanation: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number column of the employee master that matches casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'). In the client's Accumulated Report the column 'EE Citizenship Card ID' carries the document number for 248 of 261 employees and is blank for most holders of a foreigner's card (13 blanks, all foreigner-card holders); it is not a complete source. Do NOT use the column 'ID Number' of the Accumulated Report or of the Base of Withholding: it is the internal employee number (equal to Master Data 'Employee ID' for 261 of 261 employees), not an identity document; both reports also end with footer rows ('GRAND TOTAL'; 'Confidential' in Master Data) that must be excluded. COVERAGE GAP: the Accumulated Report has 1,038 payees, of whom 777 (491 pension payees of 62154 and 286 others, 132 of them paid 62100 Ordinary Salary in September 2026) have no row in the employee master data report, so a document-number source is missing for them. For pension rows the client also records a separate payee ('Beneficiary National Id'), whose meaning (substitute pensioner or third-party payee) is not confirmed; see casilla 50.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA: Confirm with the client the identification source (document type, document number and split names) for the 777 Accumulated Report payees without an employee-master row (491 pension payees of 62154 and 286 others, 132 of them paid salary in September 2026).

fields.Format: AAAA MM DD
fields.Field Explanation: First day of the certified period, output as AAAA MM DD. Normally 1 January of the tax year, but the start date of the employment relationship where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31. SOURCE (to be confirmed with the client): the client employee master carries three start dates - 'Hire Date' and 'Original Hire Date' (format DD-MM-YYYY) and 'Adjusted Service Date' (format YYYY-MM-DD); 'Hire Date' differs from 'Original Hire Date' for 40 of 261 employees, where the original date points to earlier service (masked example: Hire Date 01-03-2026, Original Hire Date 27-02-2014). Use the start of the employment relationship current in the tax year (candidate: 'Hire Date') and convert the source format to AAAA MM DD.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
fields.Query to RA: Confirm with the client which start date feeds casilla 30 for an employee who joined during the tax year: 'Hire Date', 'Original Hire Date' (differs from 'Hire Date' for 40 of 261 employees) or 'Adjusted Service Date'.

fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. CLIENT MAPPING: salary wage types evidenced in the client's accumulations include 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. The client's 'Salary Payment Indicator' flag ('X', set on 30 wage types) must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus) and on per diems (62805-62808), which belong to casillas 42 and 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts), whose casilla needs an RA decision; and it is absent from other bonuses (e.g. 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus, 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up). The engine needs an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table approved by the RA. Salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country) needs an RA decision. PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total (the client's Accumulated Report 'Total' is a rolling 12-month total, October 2025 to September 2026).
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.
fields.Query to RA: Confirm the wage-type-to-casilla table for casilla 36 and, in particular, the casilla of the leave payouts 79405-79419 flagged 'Salary Payment Indicator' = X and the treatment of salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country).

fields.Field Name (EN): Payments made with vouchers, cheques, cards or vales
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Pagos realizados con bonos electronicos o de papel de servicio, cheques, tarjetas, vales, etc.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. CLIENT EVIDENCE: the client books in-kind benefits paid to third parties as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 (identical totals) - and the same pattern for 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. Each must be assigned by the RA to casilla 37, 38 or 46 or to no casilla; the meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38. The offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.
fields.Query to RA: Assign each 'Inf.' benefit wage type (65818 meal, 65811 gym, 65809 / 65839 optical, 65812 text books, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 private health insurance, 65817 / 65837 life insurance) to casilla 37, 38 or 46 or to no casilla, and confirm the treatment of the meal benefit 65818 for an employee earning more than 310 UVT per month (casilla 37, not 38).

fields.Field Name (EN): Excess meal payments over 41 UVT (ET art. 387-1)
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Valor del exceso de los pagos por alimentacion mayores a 41 UVT, art. 387-1 E.T.
fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where meal payments to a third party exceed 41 UVT in a month AND the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Bidirectional pair with casilla 37: where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the WHOLE meal payment goes to casilla 37 instead, and casilla 38 stays nil.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instruction guide adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36. CLIENT EVIDENCE: meal payments to third parties are wage type 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079, available per employee per month (non-zero in all 12 months of the Accumulated Report). Run the test MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the month's meal payment against 41 UVT and the employee's monthly salary against 310 UVT, using the UVT parameter of the tax year (52,374 for 2026); do NOT read the UVT from the accumulated client wage type 58001 UVT, which is not always the UVT (it is doubled or altered in months with two payroll runs or retro runs). The casilla is the sum of the monthly excesses over the tax year.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

The instruction guide also directs that ECCLESIASTICAL EMOLUMENTS be included here, in money or in kind, direct or indirect, whatever the denomination and whatever the religious orientation.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid such services to this natural person.

fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer paid non-employment commissions to this natural person. Mutually exclusive with casilla 36 for the same amount.

fields.Field Explanation: Commissions - remuneration for acts, operations, dealings, mandates, business or sales carried out in one's own name but for the account of another, whether or not commercial. NOTE: commissions paid UNDER AN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT are salary under CST art. 127 and belong in casilla 36; this casilla is for non-employment commissions.

fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance savings and the interest on them. The instruction guide lists service bonus, vacaciones and work clothing among them, and directs expressly that severance savings paid to the employee go to casilla 47 and severance savings deposited to the fund go elsewhere. RECORDED DEFECT: the instruction guide for THIS casilla says the deposited severance goes to 'la casilla 48', but the form's own printed label makes casilla 48 the TRADITIONAL-REGIME severance and casilla 49 the amount deposited to the fund. The form layout is authoritative.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.
fields.Query to RA:
DEFECT IN THE OFFICIAL INSTRUCTION GUIDE, recorded. The casilla-42 instruction cross-refers severance deposited to the fund to 'casilla 48'; the form's printed label puts it at casilla 49, and casilla 48 is the traditional-regime severance. Confirm with the RA that the form layout governs.
CLIENT EVIDENCE (Accumulated Report, column 'Salary Payment Indicator'): the client flags 79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations and 62150 Vacation Bonus as salary ('X'), while 62211 Service Legal Bonus - Social Benefits and 79403 Vacations Compensated In cash carry no flag; the same flag is set on the leave payouts 79405-79419 and the per diems 62805-62808, so it may be the salary character for the contribution base rather than a Form 220 classification. Confirm (a) that vacation pay (79401, 62116, 79403) is certified in casilla 42 and not in casilla 36; (b) separately, whether 62150 Vacation Bonus, an extralegal bonus, is salary (casilla 36) under CST art. 127 / 128 or a statutory benefit; and (c) the purpose of the client flag. The Field Explanation is unchanged pending the answer.

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated where per diems were paid in the period. Related to the electronic payroll paired elements NIE072 / NIE073, which split the same amount by salary character.

fields.Field Explanation: Per diems paid to cover transport, subsistence and accommodation while the employee works away from the habitual place of work. CLIENT MAPPING: wage types 62805 Hotel per diem, 62806 Breakfast per diem, 62807 Lunch per diem and 62808 Dinner per diem. The client flags them with 'Salary Payment Indicator' = X; they are still reported here and not in casilla 36, under the casilla-36 exclusion rule.

fields.Query to RA: Give an explicit casilla (36, 42, 46 or not certified) for each earning wage type listed in the Field Explanation of casilla 46: 62131, 62700, 62590, 62591, 62112, 62811, 62523, 62540, 62310, 62320, 65821, 65800, 62138, 65803, 65804, 62180 / 62181 and 62837.

fields.Field Name (EN): Severance savings and interest paid to the employee
fields.Field Name (Local ES): Auxilio de cesantia e intereses efectivamente pagados al empleado
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Paid_To_Employee [WTC: CO-CESANTIAS (severance principal, paid directly only on termination/partial settlement) + CO-INTERESES-CESANTIAS (interest, paid directly each January)]
fields.Field Explanation: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. CLIENT MAPPING: 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments, present in most months), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (partial payments, mainly January and March 2026) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January: COP 269.0 million in the 01/01/2026 column). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Auxilio de cesantia reconocido a trabajadores del regimen tradicional del Codigo Sustantivo del Trabajo, contenido en el Capitulo VII, Titulo VIII Parte Primera

fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Traditional_Regime [No dedicated WTC code -- a regime-eligibility flag (traditional CST annual-fund regime), not itself a wage type]

Severance RECOGNISED - not necessarily paid - to employees remaining under the pre-1991 retroactive regime of CST Chapter VII, Title VIII, Part One, rather than the Ley 50 de 1990 annual-deposit regime. A shrinking but real population: employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not elect the new regime.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings

fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Cesantias_Deposited_To_Fund [WTC: CO-PROV-CESANTIAS, the employer accrual deposited to the chosen fund]
fields.Field Explanation: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure. CLIENT MAPPING: wage type 25827 Payment Severance Funds Inf. (mirrored by 65805 with the same amount - take one, not both), paid in February (COP 2,064.8 million in the 01/02/2026 column). The tax year in which a February deposit (for the balance at the preceding 31 December) is certified is an open point for the RA - see Query to RA. The provision wage types 22110 / 42110 are accruals, not the deposit.
fields.Option Values: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de severance savings

fields.Conditional Reason: Populated only where the employer itself pays a pension. Bidirectional with Form 350 casillas 78 and 94, which carry the same population monthly.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. THIS CLIENT IS A PENSION PAYER: its accumulations carry 62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 (491 pension payees, about COP 600-660 million a month), 62153 Additional Retirement Pension (paid in December and June), 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation; the RA must confirm which of these are pension income for this casilla. Pension payees are NOT in the client's employee master data report, so their identification (casillas 24-29) needs a pensioner master source. On 330 of the 491 pension rows of 62154 the client records a 'Beneficiary National Id' different from the pensioner's own document (and on 328 rows a 'Beneficiary Name' different from the employee name), i.e. a different payee (substitute pensioner or third-party payee - to be confirmed); the same columns are also filled for employees, where they match the bank-payment beneficiary, so their meaning on pension rows is not confirmed. The RA and the client must confirm to whom the certificate is issued. Pensioner health and solidarity deductions (21645 / 21646 / 21647, 21643) feed casillas 53 and 54.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.
fields.Query to RA: The client pays pensions directly (62154, 491 payees). Confirm (a) which retirement wage types are pension income for casilla 50 (62154, 62153, 62151, 62152, 62115, 62830, 62155); note that 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees sits on 17 payees, all recipients of 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV and none of 62154. Confirm (b), with BAU / the client, what a 'Beneficiary National Id' / 'Beneficiary Name' different from the pensioner means on a pension row (330 of 491 rows of 62154): a substitute pensioner (sustitucion pensional), in which case the certificate is issued to the beneficiary and casillas 24-29 need a pensioner-identity rule, or a third-party payee / bank-account holder, in which case the certificate stays with the pensioner and the columns are client-specific; for the 261 employees the same columns match the bank-payment beneficiary name in 257 cases.

fields.Field Explanation: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1 and DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41. CLIENT MAPPING: wage types 25811 Pension Voluntaria Porvenir (FVOL), 25812 Pension Voluntaria Proteccion (FVOL), 25813 Pension Voluntaria Skandia (FVOL), 25814 Pensiones Voluntarias Metlife (FVOL), 25815 Dafuturo (FVOL) and 25823 Pension Voluntaria colfondos (FVOL); their September 2026 sum equals the Base of Withholding column 'Contribution  APV' for 261 of 261 employees. The institutional-plan wage types 21210 / 21211 Plan Institucional PROTECCION and 25820 / 25821 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - IC Bonus need an RA decision (casilla 56 or not). Wage type 21193 Foncoltabaco voluntary contribution is a contribution to an employee fund, not to a pension fund, and is listed for the RA as not certified here. Because several of these fund managers also run mandatory RAIS accounts, the engine must tag each voluntary contribution as RAIS (casilla 55) or voluntary fund (casilla 56); the client data carries no such tag.

fields.Query to RA: Confirm (a) whether the institutional-plan wage types 21210 / 21211 Plan Institucional PROTECCION and 25820 / 25821 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - IC Bonus belong in casilla 56; (b) how the RAIS (casilla 55) / voluntary-fund (casilla 56) split is obtained, since the client data carries no tag; (c) that 21193 Foncoltabaco voluntary contribution (employee fund) is not certified.

fields.Conditional Reason: Required only for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies - that is, where severance savings or interest were paid or deposited. Bidirectional with casillas 47, 48 and 49: a certificate carrying any of those three should carry this average.
fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.System Mapping: Payroll.Rolling_6M_Average_Labour_Income [Calculated: rolling 6-month average of Payroll.Total_Income -- no dedicated WTC code, an engine-computed average]
fields.Field Explanation: THE ROLLING SIX-MONTH AVERAGE that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper. Severance savings and the interest on them are EXEMPT IN FULL where this average does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), and tapered above it. THE ENGINE MUST MAINTAIN THIS AVERAGE YEAR-ROUND - it cannot be reconstructed at year end from annual totals because it is a moving six-month window, and on a termination it is the average of the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

fields.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
fields.Field Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source practised on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period. Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. CLIENT MAPPING: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments - COP 63.13 million in January 2026 for one employee who also had 2552 that month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional and are NOT certified; 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country need an RA decision. The client's monthly 'Base of Withholding' shows two results, 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' and 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'; which one is the withholding certified is an open decision (in September 2026 the 2552 amount equals the WITH CONTRIBUTION value for 234 of 240 matched employees and the WITHOUT value for 180). 'CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING' (WITHOUT minus WITH where positive) is not part of 2552 and is not certified here. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.
fields.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.
fields.Query to RA: Confirm which monthly withholding result is certified: the client's Base of Withholding shows 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' and 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION' (in September 2026 the booked wage type 2552 equals WITH for 234 of 240 matched employees). Also confirm treatment of 21129 (terminations), 21140 (retirees), 25832 / 65832 (stock awards) and 25833 (IC local).

fields.Field Name (EN): ═══ employee certification under et art. 380 - display-only declarations ═══

fields.Field Name (Local ES): Certifico que durante el ano gravable (6 items)
fields.Conditional Reason: The employee signs these ONLY where they intend the certificate to substitute for their income-tax return under DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.7. All six must be true together.
fields.Position (Start-End): Printed block above the employee's signature
fields.Format: Display-only declaration
fields.Field Explanation: DISPLAY-ONLY - not a data field, not populated by payroll, not transmitted. The six declarations are: (1) gross wealth did not exceed 4,500 UVT; (2) gross income was below 1,400 UVT; (3) not a VAT-responsible person at 31 December; (4) credit-card consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (5) total purchases and consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (6) total bank deposits, receipts or financial investments did not exceed 1,400 UVT. Where all six hold, the note on the form states that THIS CERTIFICATE SUBSTITUTES FOR ALL LEGAL PURPOSES for the income-tax return. THIS IS THE ONLY REASON THE EMPLOYEE-DECLARED SECTIONS EXIST ON THE FORM.
fields.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
